name: project-scaffold
description: Bootstraps and documents projects. Initializes a repo with mirrored CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, CONTEXT.md, a PROJECT.md go-live dossier, and a secure .gitignore, then generates comprehensive docs — including an IT design-review document (docs/DESIGN.md) with inline Mermaid diagrams (business workflow, architecture, sequence, transaction, and database-schema ER), a field-typed database schema, an external-connections inventory, and an on-demand PDF export — and completes the dossier. Adopts existing projects into the playbook via /adopt-vibe (baseline audits, remediation backlog, repo migration).
